Complexes (ML<sub>5</sub>) of metals Ni and Fe have
ideal square pyramidal and trigonal
bipyramidal grometries, respectively. The sum
of the 90°, 120° and 180° L-M-L angles in the
two complexes is ________.
en.explanation:
90o = 6

120o = 3

180o = 1

Total = 10
90o = 8

180o = 2

Total = 10

Total number of 180o, 90o and 120o L-M-L bond angles = 10 + 10 = 20
